summary.business_type: Consumer social / live chat community with programmatic city, country, and interest landers
top_findings: Teen chat page targets ages 13–16 while Terms require 16+ (YMYL)
Homepage empty live modules vs 15,240+ members claim
Indexed test blog /blog/yahoo; /blog missing from sitemap
quick_wins: Align teen page with Terms/Privacy or noindex it
Replace BooBubble site_name fallbacks with Yaarzo
Noindex test blog posts; add /blog to sitemap when editorial

findings.title: www.yaarzo.com does not resolve
findings.recommendation: CNAME www to apex and 301 to https://yaarzo.com/.

findings.title: Only HSTS among security headers
findings.description: No CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Set nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options at the host.

findings.title: Public /blog missing from sitemap
findings.description: /blog returns 200 without robots/canonical and is absent from the 35-URL sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Add /blog after it is a real index; keep test posts out.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage unique product copy and single H1 (~1089 words)
CMS landers and trust pages HTTP 200
Several city pages 800–1200 words with unique H1s

findings.title: Teen 13–16 vs Terms 16+
findings.description: /teen-chat-room invites ages 13–16. Terms require at least 16. Privacy has [INSERT MINIMUM AGE].
findings.recommendation: One age policy across page, Terms, and Privacy — or noindex the teen URL.

findings.title: Thin programmatic cluster
findings.description: India, Pakistan, Friendship, Dating, Girls, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Karachi, Rawalpindi, Kolkata ~180–250 words on a shared skeleton.
findings.recommendation: Enrich or consolidate. Do not add more location URLs.

findings.title: Homepage empty states vs social proof
findings.description: 0 Members / 0 Online / 0 Chatrooms / 0 Feed Posts next to 15,240+ members copy.
findings.recommendation: Fix /api/public/landing payload or remove the claim.

findings.title: Indexed test blog
findings.description: /blog/yahoo is index, follow with title/description yahoo.
findings.recommendation: Noindex or unpublish stubs before adding /blog to the sitemap.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage title, description, canonical, H1 unique
CMS canonicals match sitemap locs; no doubled yaarzo.com/yaarzo.com on this crawl
404 template uses Page Not Found | Yaarzo and noindex, follow

findings.title: BooBubble in /communities title
findings.recommendation: Default site name to Yaarzo; never BooBubble in public head.

findings.title: Generic app titles and missing H1s
findings.description: /feed Feed, /chatroom Chatrooms, /poetry Poetry Hub; feed/chatroom/poetry/competitions have no SSR H1.
findings.recommendation: Query-shaped unique titles and one H1 per public app route.

findings.title: Organization missing logo and sameAs
findings.description: Homepage Organization has only name and url.
findings.recommendation: Add ImageObject logo and social sameAs; link WebSite via @id.

findings.title: No JSON-LD on blog routes
findings.recommendation: BlogPosting only on real posts; skip schema on yahoo stub.

findings.title: Article on chat hubs and About
findings.recommendation: WebPage + BreadcrumbList on landers; AboutPage on /about-us. Do not add FAQPage.

findings.title: Median lab LCP 2.70s
findings.description: Lighthouse 13.4.1 mobile, 5 runs, 26 Aug 2026. CrUX unavailable. Landers not re-labbed this refresh.
findings.recommendation: Treat as lab only. Connect CrUX before next score.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt does not block major AI crawlers
Homepage and restored CMS landers are SSR and quoteable

findings.title: No third-party entity graph
findings.recommendation: sameAs only after real profiles exist; do not invent llms.txt.

findings.title: CMS hotlinked images
findings.description: Some lander schema/images still point at ibb.co HTML rather than a file on yaarzo.com.
